classification.summary: The two layouts contain byte-identical logical FP16 K/V for both affected images, but physical token order changes BF16 eager-attention reduction order and flips two near-boundary Yes/No first-token decisions.

mapped_logical_kv_audit.method: For each affected image, each physical store row was mapped through stored_to_original and compared in original-token space for every FP16 element of every K and V file across all 32 layers.
mapped_logical_kv_audit.reference_store_note: This is the same fresh-raster payload used by the raster run, subsequently transformed only by recorded post-hoc permutations.

requirements: Never report the 240-request FullLoad comparison as 100% exact or as a strict pass.
Report the two mismatch qids, 99.1667% agreement, and -0.8333 percentage-point accuracy delta.
Use the same-layout FullLoad as the primary quality-delta denominator, and also expose the raster/canonical FullLoad sensitivity.
Do not interpret the separate-run FullLoad latency gap as a causal benefit of physical reordering.

evidence: The affected images have byte-identical logical FP16 K/V after applying both recorded permutations.
System K/V and visual hidden-state files have identical SHA256 hashes.
All FullLoad byte and pread counts match for all 240 requests.
The serving path deliberately loads FullLoad rows in physical stored order; RoPE is already baked into K.
Prior smoke logits are extremely close but not bitwise identical, which is expected when softmax/value reductions traverse a different physical order.
Both observed flips are the same close Yes/No token pair and occur at the first greedy decision.
root_cause_assessment.likely_cause: BF16 eager-attention finite-precision reduction-order sensitivity after a mathematically equivalent physical permutation of paired visual K/V rows.

timing_comparison.note: These are paired qid statistics from two separate executions with different companion-arm schedules and different physical files. They are descriptive, not evidence that FullLoad benefits causally from VisionZip ordering.

disagreements.question: Do you see a skateboarder that is not female?
Do the building and the sign have a different colors?

research_method_decision.rule: STRONG iff system gate, the same-layout FullLoad and calib4 quality drops are both <=2 pp, and VisionZip25 is no worse than best Raster/Morton Prefix25; PARTIAL iff system gate and VisionZip25 gains >=2 pp over the best Raster/Morton Prefix25 but misses STRONG; otherwise NO-GO.
